signin.title: Your own map, shaped by you
signin.lead: Keep the places you love, and what you remember about each visit.
signin.devFailed: Couldn't sign in. Check the user id and try again.

notInvited.title: This map is invite-only for now
notInvited.body: Your Kakao account isn't on the guest list yet. Ask the person who runs this magomap to add you.

account.title: Account
account.linkGoogle: Linking a Google account is coming later.
account.unsyncedTitle: Some notes haven't reached the server yet
account.unsyncedBody_one: {{count}} change, like a note or link, is only on this phone. It's safe here and goes out automatically when you sign in again with this account.
account.unsyncedBody_other: {{count}} changes, like notes or links, are only on this phone. They're safe here and go out automatically when you sign in again with this account.
account.deleteBody: Your notes, links, own lists and saved places are removed from magomap's server and from this device. Kakao Map, your Kakao lists and your Kakao account aren't touched. This can't be undone.
account.failed: Couldn't reach the server. Try again when you're online.
account.rejectedNote_one: {{count}} change couldn't be saved on the server. It stays on this phone, and you can copy its text from the sync status.
account.rejectedNote_other: {{count}} changes couldn't be saved on the server. They stay on this phone, and you can copy their text from the sync status.
account.deleteUnsynced_one: {{count}} change on this phone hasn't been sent yet and will be lost too.
account.deleteUnsynced_other: {{count}} changes on this phone haven't been sent yet and will be lost too.
account.signOutOffline: You can sign out once you're online. Your notes are safe on this phone.

map.locationDenied: Location is off for this site. You can turn it on in your browser settings.
map.noLocation_one: {{count}} place has no location yet. Update it in kakao-list, then import again.
map.noLocation_other: {{count}} places have no location yet. Update them in kakao-list, then import again.
map.nowUnknown: We don't know its current address.
map.empty: No places on the map yet. Search for one, or import your Kakao lists.
map.hasPrevious: Moved. Open it to see where it was.

picker.title: Lists on the map
picker.hint: Your Kakao lists show up here after you import them.

search.label: Search places
search.offline: You're offline, so this searches your saved places.
search.rateLimited: That's a lot of searches. Wait a moment, then try again.
search.unavailable: Search isn't available right now. Your saved places still work.
search.saveFailed: Couldn't save this place. Try searching again.
